# arin_delegation (Resource)

Own all nameservers and DNSSEC DS records on an existing ARIN reverse delegation. Import a zone that already has DNS records before managing it. Destroy clears all nameservers and DS records, while the delegation object remains tied to its NET. Do not overlap ownership with other DNS resources. API changes may take up to 24 hours to appear in published DNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover the zone through arin_net_delegations.
# Import first if the zone already has DNS records.
# This resource owns all NS and DS records. Destroy clears both collections.
resource "arin_delegation" "example" {
  name = "2.0.192.in-addr.arpa."
  nameservers = [
    { name = "ns1.example.net", ttl = 3600 },
    { name = "ns2.example.net", ttl = 3600 },
  ]
  ds_records = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Existing lowercase reverse zone ending in .in-addr.arpa. or .ip6.arpa., including the trailing dot.
- `nameservers` (Attributes Set) Complete authoritative nameserver collection. An empty set clears all nameservers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers))

### Optional

- `ds_records` (Attributes Set) Complete DS record collection. Omission or an empty set clears all DS records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Delegation name.

<a id="nestedatt--nameservers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nameservers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Lowercase nameserver hostname without a trailing dot.

Optional:

- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds. Omission preserves an existing nameserver TTL; new nameservers inherit TTL. To reset an explicit TTL to inheritance, remove this nameserver in one apply and add it without TTL in a subsequent apply.


<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Required:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC algorithm number.
- `digest` (String) Uppercase hexadecimal DS digest.
- `digest_type` (Number) DS digest type, for example 2 for SHA-256.
- `key_tag` (Number) DNSKEY tag, 0 through 65535.

Optional:

- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds. Omission preserves an existing record's TTL; new records inherit TTL. To reset an existing explicit TTL to inheritance, remove that DS record in one apply and add it without TTL in a subsequent apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_delegation.example 2.0.192.in-addr.arpa.
```
